metaData.title: Government Funding & Tax Incentives
metaData.description: Match your business with grants, tax incentives, and low-interest funding through AI-powered research and expert review.

hero.title: Government Funding and Tax Planning Experts for U.S. Businesses
hero.description: Our AI-powered program database and experienced tax professionals work together to match your business with federal and state grants, R&D and self-employed tax incentives, and low-interest funding.
hero.trustLine: AI-powered program discovery. Expert-reviewed applications. Nationwide coverage.

services.title: Find the right capital for your next stage

grants.title: Government Grants
grants.description: We identify relevant federal, state, and local programs, assess eligibility, and support the application process for non-repayable funding.

taxCredits.title: Tax Credits & Incentives
taxCredits.description: We evaluate R&D tax credits, self-employed tax incentives, and industry-specific programs so qualified businesses and individuals can claim available benefits compliantly.

loans.title: Low-Interest & 0% Loans
loans.description: We match businesses with SBA products, local economic-development loans, and subsidized or interest-free programs to strengthen cash flow.

ai.question: Does Jiahua use AI to prepare applications, and is it reliable?
ai.answer: We use a dual-review process: AI searches and screens thousands of federal, state, and local programs, while experienced tax and accounting professionals review every formal application. The system helps us search broadly; our experts make sure the filing is accurate.

fees.question: How does Jiahua charge for these services?
fees.answer: Our model combines a low initial evaluation fee with a success-aligned service fee paid after approval or fund disbursement. Every fee and condition is stated clearly in the service agreement, with no hidden costs.

retired.question: Why are ERC and real-estate commission claim services no longer offered?
retired.answer: The ERC filing window has expired, and Jiahua has focused its public services on government grants, R&D and other tax incentives, funding programs, and core tax and accounting work.
